description: Create a LINK between an epic, feature, user story or DEFECT and another backlog item (defect, epic, feature, story, task) — the UI's Linkages section. `linkType` is a link type name/key such as "Clones" (case-insensitive; the available types are read from the project's link-type config and an unknown one is refused with the list). `destType` is the DESTINATION issue type (e.g. "defect"). The link is saved on the SOURCE item and read back from /pm/linkages to confirm.

linkType.description: Link type name or key, e.g. "Clones".

sourceId.description: Source item id or business key (EP-64, FT-266, US-1326, DE-75).

sourceType.description: Item that owns the Linkages section (a defect too — its Linkages section).

name: backlog_link
title: Link an epic / feature / user story / defect to another item (Linkages)
